name: Nhảy theo trend
description: Ghép mặt vào video nhảy trend, 3 bước: (1) ChatGPT ghép khuôn mặt người mẫu vào khung hình video mẫu; (2) ChatGPT tạo sheet nhân vật tham chiếu từ ảnh đã ghép; (3) Grok Imagine tạo video từ ảnh ghép + sheet + video mẫu. Chọn được profile (tài khoản) cho từng bước

attachments.label: Video nhảy mẫu (video đầu ra mong muốn)
attachments.hint: File video gốc mp4/mov/webm — nên ≤ 15 giây, khung dọc
attachments.prompt: the primary base — keep its dance, timing, camera, background, lighting and outfit exactly

attachments.label: Ảnh khuôn mặt (người mẫu)
attachments.hint: Ảnh chính diện, rõ mặt, đủ sáng
attachments.prompt: replace only the dancer's face with this face identity

prompt:
Use the source video as the primary base and preserve everything exactly as in the original: same body, same dance moves, same timing, same choreography, same camera angle, same framing, same background, same lighting, same outfit, same hairstyle (if possible), same motion, same expressions timing, and same overall visual style.

Only replace the face of the dancer with the face from the provided reference image.

Requirements:
- Keep the original video unchanged except for the face.
- Maintain exact dance motion and body movement from the source video.
- Preserve the original clothes, body shape, pose, hand movements, leg movements, and scene details.
- Match the new face naturally to the head position, angle, lighting, and expression in every frame.
- Ensure the replaced face stays consistent throughout the entire video.
- Keep lip movement, head movement, and facial expressions natural and synchronized with the original performance.
- The final result should look like the same person in the original video, but with the new face identity.
- No extra changes, no redesign, no new background, no new camera movement.
- No text, no subtitles, no watermark changes.

Goal:
Create a face-replacement video where only the face is changed, while everything else remains identical to the original video.

image_steps.label: Ghép khuôn mặt
prompt: Recreate the frame from the source dance video exactly: same person's body, pose, body proportions, outfit, accessories, hairstyle, background, scene details, lighting, colors, camera angle and framing.
Replace ONLY the face with the face identity from the face reference photo.
Blend the new face naturally: match the head angle, perspective, skin tone, lighting direction, shadows and facial expression of the original frame. Keep the neck and hairline seamless.
Keep the full body visible from head to feet, vertical composition, sharp clean details.
No text, no subtitles, no logos, no watermark, no extra people, no extra limbs, no distorted hands.

inputs.role: frame from the source dance video
inputs.prompt: keep this person's body, pose, outfit, hairstyle and the whole background exactly
use only this face identity (facial features, face shape, skin tone)

video_inputs.prompt: the dancer must have exactly this face and look in every frame
